scope: Denser complete compact macros: decoder left pad, area-aware register gap, replica wordline driver in the decoder; frozen source sizing and timing

floorplan_choice.rule: For each register gap, the smallest decoder left pad that fits TIME_CONTROL by the production placement predicate; lanes are used only if they save at least 1 um over a lane-free pad; minimum estimated macro area wins

checks: Keep every source MOS, terminal, model, total W and L; compare source deck/netlist hashes, gate count and gate area with the baseline
Unpadded decoder lanes equal the previous scan; shifted lane estimates equal lanes scanned from the rebuilt padded bank
A decoder pad moves every decoder gate, via and trunk rigidly; left supply spines stay fixed
Abut register and write bands only on one shared VSS rail with exact zero gap; Calibre DRC probe of the abutment
Place the replica wordline driver only in an empty decoder top-band upper row; its rails land on the decoder rails; otherwise keep the previous placement
Keep DIN register accesses at the macro bottom edge
Keep the replica wordline return M9 landing inside the bank outline
Bridge same-net notches between routes and owned off-grid bank conductors only when clear of foreign metal
Calibre DRC zero and strict LVS CORRECT for all five complete macros
Distributed R+C+CC extraction for 32/64/128 macros; no extraction claim for 256/512
Bind receipts to actual GDS, source deck, generator, tool and rule hashes
waveform_validation: not run; physical compaction is not electrical or yield qualification
